page_title: BRE 0-0 NIC | Brest v Nice 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nice.

90+2' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' The ball is out of play and Nice manage to earn a corner.
86' A free kick is awarded to Nice.
85' Neat passing move from Brest in order to create new attacking opportunities.
84' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Martin Satriano is replaced by Axel Camblan (Brest).
83' Martin Satriano (Brest) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. It's a free kick to Nice in a dangerous position.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tom Louchet (Nice) comes onto the pitch so that Morgan Sanson can be given a rest.
80' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Romain Perraud (Nice) replaces Melvin Bard.
79' The ball is behind the touchline and Nice will take a throw-in.
77' Substitution. Mahdi Camara did his best and is replaced by Jonas Martin (Brest).
76' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
74' Brest are awarded a mid-range free kick.
74' Yellow card. Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

73' What a wasted opportunity by Steve Mounie (Brest)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Marcin Bulka makes a comfortable save to thwart him.

72' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) attempts to put the ball in from a rebound with his long-range shot, but it isn't accurate enough, and the ball goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
71' Steve Mounie receives a sweet cross inside the box from Bradley Locko (Brest), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
70' The referee signals a substitution. Steve Mounie (Brest) is brought on as a substitute for Mathias Pereira Lage.
68' Evann Guessand (Nice) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
64' Here is a change. Jordan Lotomba is going off and Francesco Farioli gives the last tactical orders to Valentin Rosier (Nice).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) replaces Gaetan Laborde.
63' Martin Satriano (Brest) is first to the cross from Romain Del Castillo, but fires his header just past the left post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
61' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
58' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
56' Evann Guessand (Nice) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Bizot is alert and denies him.
55' Nice win a corner.
55' Mahdi Camara (Brest) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
54' Morgan Sanson (Nice) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
53' 1:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
49' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) tries to find Gaetan Laborde, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Brest.
46' Lilian Brassier (Brest) brings his opponent down. Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) for his blatant foul.
44' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
43' A cross by Morgan Sanson (Nice) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
41' The ball is out of play. Brest win a corner kick.
41' Martin Satriano (Brest) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brest are going to take it.
37' Close! Martin Satriano (Brest) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar.

37' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Marcin Bulka thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
35' Evann Guessand (Nice) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
32' Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight and sees a foul from Brendan Chardonnet (Brest).
29' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
26' There's an opportunity for Morgan Sanson (Nice) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

24' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jeremy Stinat with no other option than to blow for a foul. Nice win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
23' Nice keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball. The ball is out of play. Nice will take a throw-in.
21' Bradley Locko (Brest) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
20' A player from Nice commits a rough challenge. Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
15' Brest enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
10' Nice will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
9' Evann Guessand (Nice) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. Nice get a corner.
6' The linesman makes the right call and Brest will have a corner.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

3' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Nice will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

2' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Brest will take the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat is introduced as the referee for today's match.
